title: AdaGamma: State-Dependent Discounting for Temporal Adaptation in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.06149v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The discount factor in reinforcement learning controls both the effective planning horizon and the strength of bootstrapping, yet most deep RL methods use a single fixed value across all states. State-dependent discounting is a natural way to adapt temporal credit assignment to local state structure, but naively learning a discount function inside deep actor--critic methods creates a self-referential target: the learned discount scales the same bootstrap term against which it is trained. Consequently, TD-error-based objectives can admit a degenerate shortcut, reducing target dependence on downstream value estimates instead of learning meaningful temporal structure. We propose \textbf{AdaGamma}, a practical framework for state-dependent discounting in deep actor--critic reinforcement learning. AdaGamma learns a bounded discount function \(\gamma_\phi(s)\) and trains it using a return-consistency objective that matches a one-step

translated_title: AdaGamma：强化学习中基于状态依赖折扣的时间适应方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的折扣因子同时控制着有效规划范围和自举强度，然而大多数深度强化学习方法在所有状态下都使用单一的固定值。状态依赖折扣是将时间信用分配适配到局部状态结构的一种自然方式，但在深度演员-评论家方法中朴素地学习折扣函数会产生一个自引用的目标：学习到的折扣会缩放用于训练它的同一个自举项。因此，基于TD误差的目标函数可能会陷入一种退化的捷径，即减少目标对下游价值估计的依赖，而非学习有意义的时间结构。我们提出了AdaGamma，这是一个用于深度演员-评论家强化学习中状态依赖折扣的实用框架。AdaGamma学习一个有界的折扣函数γ_φ(s)，并使用回报一致性目标对其进行训练，该目标匹配单步……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AdaGamma框架，通过回报一致性目标学习有界的状态依赖折扣函数γ(s)，解决了深度演员-评论家方法中自引用目标导致的退化捷径问题，实现时间信用分配对局部状态结构的自适应。
en_tdlr: Proposes AdaGamma, a practical framework that learns a bounded state-dependent discount function via a return-consistency objective, avoiding the degenerate shortcut caused by self-referential targets in deep actor-critic methods.
